# MDL505 · `malformed-masquerade-key`

<!-- Generated by tools/gendocs from internal/rules: do not edit. -->

A masked column is missing its closing backtick.

| | |
|---|---|
| Family | tables |
| Default severity | error |
| Fix | unsafe |
| Design references | F9 |

## Why

mydumper treats a key as a masked column only when it starts with a backtick and contains a second one: `` `email=… `` is ignored, and the column is dumped in plaintext.

## Example

❌ Before:

```ini
[`app`.`users`]
`email=random_string
`full name=constant x
```

```text
2:1-2:7 error MDL505[malformed-masquerade-key] `` `email `` is not a masked column: it has no closing backtick
  = mydumper ignores the line: the column is dumped unmasked.
  fix (unsafe): Add the closing backtick
3:1-3:11 error MDL505[malformed-masquerade-key] `` `full name `` is not a masked column: it has no closing backtick
  = mydumper ignores the line: the column is dumped unmasked.
```

✅ After `mydumper-lint check --fix --unsafe-fixes`:

```ini
[`app`.`users`]
`email`=random_string
`full name=constant x
```

## Configuration

Enabled by default. To change its severity or turn it off:

```yaml
rules:
  severity:
    MDL505: warning   # or error, info, off
```

To accept one occurrence, put `# mydumper-lint: disable-next-line=MDL505` on the line above it.
